Welcome.Title: MR · Cuentos de Ánimas
Welcome.Body: The Table of Souls never opens by itself: find it in the left toolbar (moon), in the directories, or with Shift+M.

spirit.Title: Spirit
spirit.Short: Your balance. Lost when failing an obstacle or facing a Grey Lady.
spirit.Long: The cold stones are Spirit. When one goes out, the story grows colder. Running out of Spirit does not end the story: play goes on, but the epilogue will be the one the table gives for 0.

determination.Title: Resolve
determination.Short: Your will. Spend it to tilt an obstacle your way.
determination.Long: Before revealing the number card it adds +2; afterwards, +1 if that is enough. From the second Grey Lady it also lets you reveal again. Each spent ember goes out in the tray.

deck.Title: Deck of Souls
deck.Short: Each card opens a scene: clue, obstacle, mishap or Grey Lady.
deck.Long: The deck has three blocks with one Grey Lady in each. The player never sees what comes; the Guardian only sees how many cards remain in each block.

gray.Title: Grey Ladies
gray.Short: Three thresholds of tension. Each hardens the story; the third opens the epilogue.
gray.Long: When she appears she asks for her price (Resolve or Spirit) and raises obstacle difficulty by 1.

number.Title: Number card
number.Short: 1 to 10. Match or beat the difficulty to overcome the obstacle.
number.Long: What adds up: the card, +2 if you spent Resolve before revealing, and +1 if you push afterwards.

spend.Title: Spend before revealing
spend.Short: One Resolve: +2 to the card you are about to reveal.

push.Title: Push
push.Short: Only if you are 1 short: one Resolve turns it into a success.

reroll.Title: Reveal again
reroll.Short: From the second Lady: one Resolve to reveal another card.

discard.Title: Discard
discard.Short: Cards already played. The top one is the card before the current one.

card-environment.Title: Environment obstacle
card-environment.Short: The physical world turns hostile. Has a difficulty.

card-character.Title: Character obstacle
card-character.Short: A human conflict. Has a difficulty.

card-incident.Title: Mishap
card-incident.Short: Something changes, breaks or is lost. No test.

card-gray.Title: Grey Lady
card-gray.Short: Tension takes a step. She asks for her price.

diary.Title: Diary
diary.Short: Scenes are noted by themselves; you write what the protagonist felt.

history.Title: Chronicle
history.Short: A structured record of everything that happened, to rebuild the session.

truths.Title: Truths
truths.Short: What the protagonist claims. The story may cast doubt on it.
truths.Long: Established, doubtful, contradicted, reinterpreted, pending revelation or resolved. It is not about catching the player out: it is about finding which story they were telling themselves.

memories.Title: Memories
memories.Short: Questions and answers about the past. They can be locked or contradict each other.

guardian.Title: Guardian
guardian.Short: Compact game control: deck, scene, resources and record.

library.Title: Library
library.Short: Scenarios to play, edit, duplicate or import.

safety.Title: Safety
safety.Short: Pause, Veil and X-Card. Anonymous and immediate.

access.Title: Accessibility
access.Short: Text size, contrast, motion and sound.

blocks.Title: Deck blocks
blocks.Short: Cards left in each third and whether its Lady is still inside. Never which card.

split.Title: Split
split.Short: Ten points between Spirit and Determination, at least 3 and at most 7 in each. It is set when the protagonist is created; once the story is running it cannot change.

traits.Title: Traits
traits.Short: Four words or phrases that define the protagonist and spark ideas.

objects.Title: Objects
objects.Short: What they carry. Starred ones matter to the story.

bonds.Title: Bonds
bonds.Short: People who matter: who, what binds you, what parts you.

story.Title: The story
story.Short: Synopsis, clues found and tension revealed, always at hand to re-read. It can be folded.

synopsis.Title: Synopsis
synopsis.Short: The scenario's opening narration. Read at the start and kept here to re-read.

clues.Title: Clues found
clues.Short: Every chosen Clue stays here, outside the discard pile. Click one to enlarge it.

collection.Title: Included collection
collection.Short: Scenarios bundled with the system. Add them to your world to play or edit them.

random.Title: Random protagonist
random.Short: Fills the whole dossier with a random combination that follows the rules. Each field's dice rerolls only that field.

creation.Title: Creating the protagonist
creation.Short: What the book asks for: name, profession, place of origin, physical description, short background, four traits or objects and the 10-point split.

ImportHelp.Title: How to import scenarios
ImportHelp.Intro: The Library imports scenarios from a JSON file. Write it by hand with the template, or ask an AI with the prompt below and paste the scenario text.
ImportHelp.File1: JSON in UTF‑8 with a .json extension. It can live in any folder on your computer.
ImportHelp.File2: Pick it from Library → Import. No need to copy it into Foundry's folders.
ImportHelp.File3: One file can hold one or many scenarios, inside the «scenarios» list.
ImportHelp.File4: Everything is plain text: separate paragraphs with a blank line (\n\n). No HTML needed.
ImportHelp.PromptTitle: Prompt to generate it with an AI
ImportHelp.PromptIntro: Copy this into your AI and paste the scenario after it (from the PDF or your own). Save the answer as a .json file and import it.
ImportHelp.Errors: Every scenario is checked before touching the world. Valid ones are imported; for the rest you will see exactly what is missing. A malformed JSON is not imported and changes nothing.
ImportHelp.Prompt:
Convert the «Cuentos de ánimas» scenario pasted at the end into a JSON file for the MR · Cuentos de Ánimas system for Foundry VTT.

Answer ONLY with the JSON, no explanations or code fences.

Use exactly this structure and these field names:
{template}

Rules:
- Keep «format» and «version» as they are.
- Copy the scenario's texts without summarising. Separate «synopsis» paragraphs with \n\n.
- «synopsis»: the synopsis or introduction read aloud at the start.
- «characters»: supporting characters, each with «name» and «description».
- «clues», «environmentObstacles» and «characterObstacles»: one sentence per entry. No difficulty: the card provides it.
- «incidents»: usually empty; mishaps befall a supporting character.
- «tension»: exactly three texts, first, second and third Grey Lady.
- «epilogues»: one entry per row of the Spirit‑Epilogue table, in the same order, with «label» (the condition as written), «min» and «max» (Spirit counters it covers; 99 = no limit) and «text». There must be a row with min 0.
- «modes»: choose among {modes}.
- «tags»: choose among {tags}.
- If the scenario has an author's note not meant for players, put it in «guardianNotes».
- Fill «author» and «source» with authorship and origin.

Scenario:

Field.name: Scenario title.
Field.synopsis: Opening narration read at the start; stays visible on the Table.
Field.environmentObstacles: Environment obstacles: one sentence per entry.
Field.characterObstacles: Character obstacles: one sentence per entry.
Field.tension: Tension table: three texts, one per Grey Lady.
Field.epilogues: Spirit‑Epilogue table: { label, min, max, text }; the first row including the final Spirit is used.
Field.author: Authorship.
Field.incidents: Own mishaps (optional; otherwise a character is chosen).
Field.guardianNotes: Notes only for whoever runs the game.
